title: An Image Everyone Can Understand
prompt:
Add an image to the page: `src` `/images/sunrise.jpg`, with `alt` text that would let someone who cannot see the picture know what it shows — write `Sunrise over a mountain lake`.

Rules:
- One `img` element with both `src` and `alt`.
- The alt text is written for people, not for search engines.
boilerplate:
Morning pages

Every walk starts before the sun does.

tests.name: an img with src and alt
tests.hint: — both attributes are required.

tests.name: points at the sunrise image
tests.hint: Copy the src from the instructions: /images/sunrise.jpg

tests.name: alt text describes the picture
tests.hint: Alt text speaks the picture aloud: 'Sunrise over a mountain lake'.
